title: Traktor Academy Source Record
description: A captured piece of evidence about Native Instruments Traktor or Traktor-compatible hardware. One record per source, stored at research/sources/src-####.json. A source record exists to make a claim re-checkable by someone who was not present when it was captured.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, including for withdrawn sources.

title.description: Title exactly as the source presents it. Do not paraphrase.

publisher.description: Who published it. For community sources, the identifiable author or platform.

tier.description: Evidence tier assigned at capture time. T0 = official NI documentation (highest authority). T1 = official NI-adjacent. T2 = third-party hardware manufacturer documentation. T3 = reputable attributable community. T4 = forums and anecdotes. Tier is a property of the source, not of the claim.

url.description: Exact URL as retrieved. Not a canonicalised or cleaned-up form. Local captures use urn:local:.

captured_at.description: ISO date the source was retrieved. Mandatory: web sources change silently and an undated citation cannot be re-checked.

published_at.description: ISO publication date, or the literal string 'unknown' where the source does not state one. Never guessed.

raw_ref.description: Directory under research/raw/ holding the immutable capture. Every source record must point at a real capture.

version_context.description: Which Traktor version(s) the source addresses, or 'unknown' where it does not say. A source that is correct for one version only is a common failure mode.

applies_to.description: Products, versions or hardware the source covers. ['unknown'] is a valid and honest value; an invented list is not.

confidence_notes.description: Anything weakening this source: marketing rather than documentation, undated, vendor describing Traktor software, apparent translation, superseded edition.

status.description: active = usable. link_broken = URL no longer resolves; the record is kept because claims still cite it. superseded = replaced by a newer source, which is named in confidence_notes. withdrawn = determined invalid; never deleted, so the audit trail survives.

superseded_by.description: Id of the replacing source (src-####) when status is superseded, otherwise null.

retrieved_by.description: Role or agent that performed the capture.
